verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no S3-compatible endpoint, no cloud-storage sync, and no transfer tooling. The related items fall outside the credit boundary: shared drives give storage across machines in a private network, VMs have "free unlimited bandwidth", and SSH access would let a user arrange their own copies. These are adjacent features or user-side workarounds, not an efficient data-transfer capability. A community report that copying datasets in is very slow reinforces the absence rather than contradicting any vendor claim.
